allocation.H2: qMax if predicted net payoff(qMax)>0 else0
allocation.scope: sequential conditional campaign sizing, not global joint optimum

budget.stopping: Run whole matrix once. Implementation defects documented with invalidated evidence; no winner-based revisions.

data_admission.actions: Effective dates conditional; process_date not ex_date completeness; no knownAt invented; unsupported affecting action blocks
data_admission.available_at: bar end+1second modeled, not original received timestamp
data_admission.failure: DATA_BLOCKED, no silent fallback to shorter evaluated period
data_admission.grid: All received calendar RTH5min slots; no imputation; old prefix unchanged
data_admission.price_adjustment: Tool lacks adjustment parameter; endpoint raw default assumed, not certified
data_admission.request_partition: One symbol per complete interval, limit10000; narrow if truncated; at most2 targeted attempts per missing interval

decision.deadline: 24or72elapsedhours clipped to last executable RTH slot; calendar-only terminal admission
decision.exit_policy: Native CLOSED_CHANNEL BASELINE two25percent rounded-down partials plus protected remainder
decision.quantity_budget_price: common IOC limit, never future open
decision.reference_price: last completed bar close available at decision
decision.reservation: actual quantity times common IOC and per-share fee/risk; same rule for all new policies; unresolved reserves retained
decision.terminal_cutoff: Reject horizon if calendar deadline exceeds source-end close
decision.tie_break: rank descending then symbol ascending; H1/CONT choose strongest qualifying signed residual each day

forecast.fixed_costs: Shared account calendar overhead once, outside targets
forecast.gross_calibration_target: raw deadline return, MSE vs zero
forecast.gross_target: (deadline_open-entry_open)/refPrice before policy exits/friction, zero if common IOC no-fill
forecast.model_uncertainty: daily-cluster HAC lag5 ridge sandwich approximation, coverage not certified
forecast.net_calibration_target: q4 normalized net=0.5(E+T), MSE vs zero
forecast.purge: Full deadline cohort known_at even early stops/no-fill; calibration fit labels known before first calibration decision
forecast.warmup: 90past residual observations then90matured forecast sessions; all calendar costs charged while abstaining

limitations: Two surviving traded names, reused history, modeled OHLCV execution.
Extension downloaded after freeze is historical, not prospective.
Same caps do not imply matched realized risk; taxes excluded.
objective: Test realizable net policy-payoff forecasts and discrete sizing without increasing risk. 8/10 is an economic goal, not an observed score.

residual.method: OLS stock first60min on XLK first60min, past decisions only; same residual_z feature

statistics.concentration_gate: net positive after exclusion of largest winner in both scenarios; report top5 too
statistics.concentration_scope: Arithmetic subtraction from observed account PnL with fixed overhead retained, not a counterfactual compounded replay
statistics.decision: REJECT if net<=0 either scenario or risk violation; INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE if support/concentration/bootstrap fail; else DIAGNOSTIC_CANDIDATE, no live promotion
statistics.primary_endpoint: continuous compound account log growth after variable and UTC calendar costs
statistics.recent_extension: Retrospective descriptive window in same account, no reset, not prospective
statistics.reference_cash: zero yield minus same overhead; bookkeeping only
statistics.risk_check_scope: Native event drawdown and session close-to-close loss; admission caps and every-event reservation diagnostics reported. This gate does not certify a per-mark daily-loss bound.
statistics.risk_comparison: same caps, exposure reported; no risk-equivalent alpha certification
